'''Jahnae Camp''' was a [[City/Legends|settlement]] on [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] that was perched on a jutting [[Island spires/Legends|island spire]] of rock that protruded out into Bestine's primary [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]].<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
